h: Shabbos Bestows Wisdom Wealth and the Strength of Humility

p: הוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
This is based on what is written in the holy Zohar
depend on the seventh day," etc.,
וְכֵן הוּא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם סג, ב)
And so it is in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 63b):
And in the Zohar Chadash (in the Tikkunim, 112a):
"That elder, one of those elders, arose
it would have implied Chanoch, Metatron;
but the Hei that is added
'The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich,'" etc.
וְכֵן הוּא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קסו, א)
And so it is in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 166a):
"'The angel of Hashem encamps round about'
And so wrote the Ramban, of blessed memory,
on the pasuk "The angel who redeems,"
and on the pasuk "Behold, I send an angel"
But here it says in the Zohar Chadash
and it brought the pasuk "the blessing of Hashem,"
which is written with the Name Havayah.
אַךְ הוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב
But this is based on what is written
בְּזֹאת יָבֹא אַהֲרֹן וְגוֹמֵר (וַיִּקְרָא טז, ג)
and concludes that this is the secret of
עַל זֹאת יִתְפַּלֵּל כָּל חָסִיד (תְּהִלִּים לב, ו)
"For this let every pious one pray" (Tehillim 32:6):
to the Name Hashem that is over 'zos.'
Why did they institute in Shacharis
is in each and every sefirah,
'Yours, Hashem, is the greatness and the might,' etc.;
and no sefirah has any action
And this is why it said
"The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich";
and it refers to the attribute of Malchus,
for all the actions of all the sefiros
הֵם עַל יְדֵי מִדָּה זוֹ כָּאָמוּר
are through this attribute, as stated.
"The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich"
And it opened in the Zohar Chadash there:
"'With this shall Aharon come into the holy place'
אֵין אָדָם מֵפִיק רְצוֹן הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
no man obtains the favor of the Holy One, blessed be He,
וְכֵן נִדְרָשׁ (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כא, ו)
And likewise it is expounded (Vayikra Rabbah 21:6):
"'With this' — in the merit of Shabbos:
אַשְׁרֵי אֱנוֹשׁ יַעֲשֶׂה זֹּאת (יְשַׁעְיָה נו, ב)
'Happy is the man who does this'" (Yeshayahu 56:2);
for Shabbos is the attribute of Malchus,
And it said in the Zohar Chadash:
"And when the Shechinah, which is called 'zos,'
when they are in the land of their enemies,'" etc.
And so it is in the holy Zohar
שֶׁזֶּה סוֹד עַל זֹאת יִתְפַּלֵּל כָּל חָסִיד וְגוֹמֵר
that this is the secret of "For this let every pious one pray," etc.,
מָצָא אִשָּׁה מָצָא טוֹב וְכוּלֵּי (מִשְׁלֵי יח, כב)
"Whoever finds a wife finds good," etc. (Mishlei 18:22);
that no sefirah has any action
except through the attribute of Malchus,
"Let not the wise man glory," etc.,
and these are the three gifts that were created in the world:
took all the delight of the world," etc.;
When they are gifts of Heaven," etc.
(as is written in Midrash Rabbah and Tanchuma, Matos,
And this is what the prophet said:
"Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom,
nor let the mighty man glory in his might,
nor let the rich man glory in his riches;
when they come through the Shechinah,
for all the actions of the sefiros
and the wealth of Rav Chisda,
and they gave them to me;
the humility of Rabbah bar Rav Huna,
and they did not give it to me."
These are the three things mentioned:
and the main might of conquering the inclination
is through the attribute of humility,
for the beginning of the serpent's enticement
from what arose in His will, may He be blessed,
the main point being that they recognize the power of His kingship,
that He is King of the worlds;
"Hashem reigns; He is clothed in majesty"
מִזֶּה נִסְתָּעֵף בַּקְּלִיפָּה גַּם כֵּן הַגַּאֲוָה
from this pride also branched out in the kelipah.
It is the secret of the primeval kings who died,
that it came about through the kelipah of pride,
for each one said, "I will reign,"
and this is the root of the evil inclination.
וְכֵן כָּתַב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א רב, א)
And so it wrote in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 202a):
in a place where there is," etc.,
is the mighty one who conquers his inclination.
and the humility of Rabbah bar Rav Huna
וְהוּא נִרְאֶה כְּמוֹ הַחוֹמֵד בְּשֶׁל חֲבֵירוֹ
it appears like one who covets what belongs to his fellow;
simply for wisdom, wealth and humility?
Is it then from one who has no fixed portion?
and this indicates words of Torah,
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (מִשְׁלֵי כד, ד)
and it is in the manner of what is said (Mishlei 24:4):
"And by knowledge are the chambers filled
with all precious and pleasant wealth";
הוֹן הַמְכוּוָּן עַל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
וְעַל זֶה מוֹרֶה שְׁמוֹ רַב הוּנָא
and to this his name Rav Huna points.
that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach,
through the power of the Shechinah,
which is called "zos," as mentioned above.
וְזֶה עִנְיַן עַל זֹאת יִתְפַּלֵּל וְגוֹמֵר
And this is the meaning of "For this let pray," etc.:
that all the action of the sefiros among the lower beings
And Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who was a chariot for the attribute of Gedulah,
"And Avraham was old, advanced in days";
that is, in the first three sefiros,
to merit the revelation of the attribute of Atika;
and this is what they said (Bava Metzia 87a):
"Until Avraham there was no old age."
That is, the attribute of Gedulah
was in him in an expansiveness
"the Supernal Crown, which is the Crown of Malchus."

p: that the first blessing of man and of fish
and I will remove sickness," etc.,
"the number of your days I will fulfill,"
and mazal is the aspect of Atika,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג עט, ב)
Yud to Chochmah, Hei to Binah,
and the upper tip of the Yud
which is the aspect of Atika.
And this is the meaning of "upon Havayah" precisely:
that it is above the Name Havayah.
And this is the secret of
וַתִּתְפַּלֵּל חַנָּה עַל ה׳ (שְׁמוּאֵל א א, י)
הַשְׁלֵךְ עַל ה׳ יְהָבְךָ (תְּהִלִּים נה, כג)
as is written in the holy Zohar.
Therefore there are counted with Rav Chisda
רַב חִסְדָּא חָיָה צ״ב שְׁנִין וְכוּלֵּי
בֵּי רַב חִסְדָּא שִׁתִּין הִלּוּלֵי וְכוּלֵּי
"in the house of Rav Chisda there were sixty weddings," etc.
"in the house of Rav Chisda there was fine flour for the dogs,
That is, he merited through his attribute of abundant kindness
up to the aspect of the holy Mazal;
עַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכָה לְכָל הַג׳ בְּרָכוֹת
through this he merited all three blessings,
and this was through the attribute of Chesed
like Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him.
And as for his asking for the wealth of Rav Chisda
and the wisdom of Rav Huna
he did not ask for their share,
only that he merit wisdom and wealth
like Rav Huna and Rav Chisda,
who merited it through the Shechinah,
אַל יִתְהַלֵּל וְגוֹמֵר כִּי אִם בְּזֹאת
וְאָמַר עִנְוְותָנוּתֵיהּ דְּרַבָּה בַּר רַב הוּנָא
And he said, "the humility of Rabbah bar Rav Huna
This is according to what I heard
from our holy Rebbe, of blessed memory,
regarding why it is called in the Gemara (Nedarim 25a)
אַף שֶׁהַקָּנֶה הָיָה שֶׁל הַבַּעַל דִּין
although the cane belonged to the litigant
שֶׁלֹּא יָצָא מִבֵּית דִּינוֹ דִּין מְרוּמֶּה
that no deceitful judgment left his court,
and it was clarified through the cane;
therefore the cane is called by his name.
And of him we find in the Shas:
in the end the matter came to light," etc.
he merited to arrive at the truth.
And similar is found in the Shas
and therefore it is called "Rava's cane."
And as for its saying "he was embarrassed"
אַף שֶׁבּוֹ מָצִינוּ כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים בַּשַּׁ״ס
although of him we find many times in the Shas:
"he then appointed a meturgeman and expounded:
The things I said before you
were a mistake on my part";
וְגַם מָצִינוּ כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים בַּשַּׁ״ס אֶצְלוֹ
and we also find many times in the Shas of him
that he admitted and was not ashamed to say,
in these places, the wording is "he was embarrassed."
he had not yet merited complete humility;
and this is what he said:
"the humility of Rabbah bar Rav Huna
And it says further in the Zohar Chadash there:
'And this is what their father spoke to them.'"
that the tribes said to Yaakov Avinu:
"Just as in your heart there is only One"
for in him the Unity was explicit
"so in our heart there is only One";
although the Unity does not shine
we believe that Hashem is One;
as is written in the holy Zohar
"He is Truth and She is Faith."
And this is what it says:
"And this is what their father spoke to them";
that is, to them he spoke
and informed them with the attribute of "zos,"
for this is their attribute: "She is Faith."
for David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
was a chariot for the attribute of Malchus,
descends the kingship of the house of David,
הָיָה גַּם כֵּן מֶרְכָּבָה לְמִדַּת זֹאת
was also a chariot for the attribute of "zos."

p: we find in the three Avos.
אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם זָכָה לְחָכְמָה
Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him, merited wisdom,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה סא, א)
And of Yitzchak we find (Bereishis Rabbah 64:7):
and not the silver and gold of Avimelech."
And Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
as we find that he said (Tehillim 121:1):
I lift my eyes to the mountains"
to those who taught me and those who formed me
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּצֵא, סח, ב)
(as is written in Bereishis Rabbah, beginning of Vayeitzei, 68:2);
שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
as they said in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 204a):
the secret of the three Avos,
and the daughter is crowned with them"
through it one merits all three gifts:
Shabbos is the time of Torah,
for according to all, the Torah was given on Shabbos;
and it is also the time for the bestowal
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א מז, ב)
"The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich"
for it is stated in the Mechilta (Vayassa 6):
"'And keeps his hand from doing any evil'" (Yeshayahu 56:2);
and in Pri Etz Chaim it is stated
that one is saved from the accusation of the evil inclination.
at the beginning of Tanna Devei Eliyahu (Rabbah 1),
"But to this one will I look,
to the poor and contrite of spirit"
as referring to the day of Shabbos.
